fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { annualCensus: "Build an annual employee engagement survey for my company of 600 people. Use 40 statements on a 1-5 agreement scale, with core engagement items first and sections on managers, growth, recognition and workload. Keep it open two weeks, remind only people who have not answered and hide results for any group with fewer than five answers. Give each manager a dashboard with their team's index, eNPS, the driver most tied to its engagement and an action log.", frontlineStaff: "Build an anonymous engagement survey for my store and warehouse staff, who have no company email. Each site gets its own QR code for the break room. The survey has 12 questions, takes two minutes on a phone, runs in English or Spanish and asks for no name or email. Tag every response to its site, and hide a site's results from its manager until that site has five answers.", afterReorg: "Build a short engagement survey for the teams affected by our reorg, sent six weeks after the change. Ask about role clarity and trust in leadership, and include the intent-to-stay item. Compare each team's scores with its last annual census, and alert the HR business partner in Slack when a team's intent to stay drops 10 points or more.", quarterlyCheckIn: "Build a quarterly eNPS survey for my company. Ask the 0-10 question on recommending us as a place to work and one open question on what would raise the score. Track the company eNPS quarter over quarter on a live dashboard, and group the comments into themes with a count for each." };

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: An annual engagement census shows each team's response count, engagement index, eNPS and focus driver, hides Legal at three answers and asks the Support manager to log actions on workload.
